comment: Exercise 15.1: MiniDAQ's hazard chains, rated before risk control. Severities and probabilities are teaching choices (assumption: confirm with team).

chains.sequence: The link drops packets at a high count rate, or the source drops words under overload; the run ends normally and reports no loss.
chains.hazardous_situation: Images are reconstructed from incomplete data that is treated as complete.
chains.harm: A quantitation error contributes to a delayed or incorrect diagnosis.

chains.hazard: Last coincidences of every run missing
chains.sequence: Windows still open when the run stops are never closed, so their coincidences are not written and no counter shows it.
chains.hazardous_situation: Every scan lacks its last coincidences, with no sign of it.
chains.harm: A small, systematic quantitation error in late frames of dynamic scans.

chains.sequence: The time unwrapping fails across a wrap of the time code after a gap longer than half a wrap period.
chains.hazardous_situation: Coincidences are formed from the wrong singles.
chains.harm: Artifacts contribute to a delayed or incorrect diagnosis.

chains.sequence: One board's stream lags the merge, and its singles reach the sorter after windows they belong to have closed.
chains.hazardous_situation: True coincidences are missed and randoms are counted wrongly.
chains.harm: Quantitation errors contribute to an incorrect diagnosis.

chains.sequence: A disk error or a power loss damages a block while the file is written.
chains.hazardous_situation: The damaged file is reconstructed as if it were intact.
chains.harm: Artifacts contribute to an incorrect diagnosis.

chains.hazard: A short file under its final name
chains.sequence: The server crashes after a file was renamed but before its data reached the disk.
chains.hazardous_situation: A truncated file looks complete to the consumer.
chains.harm: A quantitation error contributes to an incorrect diagnosis.

chains.sequence: Two runs get the same name and the second writes into the first one's files.
chains.hazardous_situation: A file set holds coincidences of two acquisitions, possibly of two patients.
chains.harm: Activity from another acquisition contributes to an incorrect diagnosis.

chains.hazard: Simulated data stored as a patient scan
chains.sequence: A configuration at the scanner selects the synthetic source.
chains.hazardous_situation: Invented data is reconstructed as a patient's scan.

chains.sequence: A misspelled key falls back to its default energy window.
chains.hazardous_situation: Data is acquired with a window that reconstruction does not assume.
chains.harm: Wrong scatter correction contributes to a quantitation error and an incorrect diagnosis.

chains.sequence: A process on the acquisition PC connects to the control port and sends stop during a scan.
chains.hazardous_situation: The scan is incomplete and must be repeated.
chains.harm: Additional radiation dose from a second injection, or a delayed diagnosis.
